ha_child_devices.markdownDescription:
[EXPERIMENTAL] HA child devices mode

When enabled, each output/input/cover/sensor is registered as a separate
child device in Home Assistant (linked via via_device to the main boneIO device).
This allows HA to auto-generate dashboards per area.
Entity names become empty so HA uses the device name directly.
WARNING: Experimental feature — may change or be removed in future versions.
ha_child_devices.title: Ha child devices

ha_child_devices_naming.markdownDescription:
Child device naming style

Controls how child device names are constructed when ha_child_devices is enabled.
- default: Entity name only (e.g., "OUT 17"). May cause duplicates if multiple boneIO devices share output names.
- device_name: Adds boneIO device name prefix (e.g., "boneIO Black - OUT 17").
- device_name_area: Adds device name and area (e.g., "boneIO Black - Living Room - OUT 17"). Falls back to device_name if no area is assigned.
ha_child_devices_naming.title: Ha child devices naming

serial_override.markdownDescription:
Serial number override

Override the auto-detected serial number (based on MAC address).
Use this when restoring config from a different device (e.g., RMA replacement).
Format: blk followed by 6 hex characters (e.g., blk8c7df0).
WARNING: Two devices with the same serial on the same MQTT broker will conflict!
serial_override.title: Serial override
